An infestation of white ants was discovered in the Period
Costume Room and has been dealt with immediately as an individual
case by a major pest control organisation. However, in view of
other evidence of serious white ant damage e.g. various door
frames, a full inspection and survey has been made by the same
organisation and it is hoped to have their report available in
time for this Meeting. In reference to the one particular in-
festation in the Period Costume Room, a case containing a large
array of children's clothing was affected and it should be recorded
that Mrs.G.A.C.Kiernan's assistance once again in the proper pro-
cessing of the clothing was absolutely invaluable.

<u>Minutes of a Meeting held at Vaucluse House on
Sunday 15th April, 1973 at 10 a.m.</u>

Accounts paid since the last Recoupment Summary was
submitted to the Board are as detailed on Summaries No. 40/41/42/43
as tabled. These have been passed for payment and reimbursed by
the N.P. & W.S. and formal confirmation is therefore requested.
It should also be noted under this heading that the necessary pro-
formas are now to hand from N.P. & W.S. regarding the preparation
of Estimates for 1973/74. These are to be forwarded by 30th April
and although to be drafted by the Secretary/Manager and submitted
to the Executive for discussion and approval prior to dispatch,
this Meeting provides a good opportunity for Trustees to consider
any special projects which they might wish to see included. It is
interesting to note that despite the urgent action demanded back
in February in respect of our requirements under General Loan Funds,
the pro-forma Estimates and a subsequent enquiry of N.P. & W.S.
substantiate that we have been excluded entirely from any provision.
